top_uncovered_capabilities.capability: Signature trust-chain + tamper detection + LTV forged-GOOD
top_uncovered_capabilities.why: Cert trust is never positively validated (self-signed satisfies every predicate); the tamper test has an operator-precedence bug that may write a no-op; no test rejects a GOOD OCSP from an untrusted responder. A signature from an attacker-controlled issuer is indistinguishable from a trusted one.

The edit path is visual but oracles are extraction-present; mirror/invisible/white/wrong-glyph/wrong-position edits and neighbour-span clobbering (the shipped ambient-state-leak class) all pass. MultiplePageEdits has zero assertions; the adversarial-ambient corpus test is SUCCEED()-only.

Every alignment test uses extractPlainText().find(); position/x-offset is never asserted — text drawn left when Center/Right requested passes. Justify has a substring bug making fully un-justified output pass.

Reconstruction writes new glyphs into the content stream but nothing renders/re-extracts the output; the 'critical' Y-flip coord-mapper tests are tautological (never call the product mapper). Wrong/garbled/mirrored/off-page reconstructed text ships green.

Success is asserted via return bool / non-null display list; a wrong CTM producing a mirrored or HALF-SIZE image (a bug class this subsystem has repeatedly hit) is indistinguishable from correct. Only image_ctm_leak/mediabox_origin_crop pin geometry.

autosave_capture_audit (15 edit families) is SUCCEED()-only with ZERO EXPECT/ASSERT — finishRow() records capture_present=NO as passing data. A crash-recovery regression that drops all edits produces a green suite (the exact data-loss class this project keeps shipping).

BasicSearch/SearchPage_FindsText assert totalMatches()>=0 (a tautology); quad/hit checks are in loops that run zero times when empty. Broken indexing returning zero hits for text actually on the page is invisible.

OcrOnScannedPdf asserts hocr non-empty + blocks>0; gibberish recognition passes because no known word from the fixture is checked. RenderPageAt300Dpi accepts >100px so a DPI regression silently degrades OCR input.
